details: The rule "talk to me in my native language" is text only and failed: on 24 Oct (session 3207dc59) the full report after a long English tool stretch came out in English. Owner, verbatim: "Ты ответил мне на английском - что-то здесь не так"; then "1. a, но это не должна быть строгая проверка на то чтобы каждый символ соответствовал языку, это приведет к ложному срабатыванию, достаточно процентного покрытия".
failing_case: The front's English report of 24 Oct (3038 chars, Cyrillic share of prose letters 0%) reached the owner unchanged.
pass_cases: That English reply is blocked once with the rewrite instruction; the Russian reply that followed (Cyrillic share 97%, with terms like workflow, OpenSpec, $9 and file paths) passes; a reply that is almost all code or paths (under ~40 prose letters) passes; with native_language unset or English nothing is checked; a second stop after one block is let through (no loop).
findings.path: plugins/front/hooks (a new Stop hook), projects.toml [global] native_language
findings.summary: A reply to the owner can come out in the wrong language
